title: TabDAT
summary: TabDAT is a tabular-data synthesis benchmark repository containing multiple baseline generative models (shallow, deep, and SDV-based) for comparison. One baseline directly instantiates and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CopulaGANSynthesizer alongside standalone ctgan and rdt calls to produce synthetic tabular data as one of several comparison baselines.
